prompt_en:
Build a decision log distinguishing proposals from actual approvals.

Document (fictional data):
Line 1. Sara, responsible for the building services department, reports case P13-000, status approved, budget 6749 euros, deadline 2026-11-14. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 2. Tommaso, responsible for the structures department, reports case P13-001, status suspended, budget 2335 euros, deadline 2026-11-15. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 3. Anna, responsible for the construction department, reports case P13-002, status under review, budget 7802 euros, deadline 2026-11-16. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 4. Bruno, responsible for the building services department, reports case P13-003, status approved, budget 3342 euros, deadline 2026-11-17. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 5. Carla, responsible for the structures department, reports case P13-004, status approved, budget 8871 euros, deadline 2026-11-18. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 6. Diego, responsible for the construction department, reports case P13-005, status suspended, budget 3237 euros, deadline 2026-11-19. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 7. Elena, responsible for the building services department, reports case P13-006, status under review, budget 6743 euros, deadline to be defined. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 8. Fabio, responsible for the structures department, reports case P13-007, status approved, budget 2542 euros, deadline 2026-11-21. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 9. Giulia, responsible for the construction department, reports case P13-008, status approved, budget 5062 euros, deadline 2026-11-22. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 10. Irene, responsible for the building services department, reports case P13-009, status suspended, budget 2002 euros, deadline 2026-11-23. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 11. The proposal to bring all deadlines forward has not been approved. The stated amounts are estimates, not actual costs.

Keep the answer concise: at most about 120 words, or the requested code or data. Do not include internal reasoning.
